RVA-F-0333.falsification: Different definition mask, mode branch, SDI predicates, damage-call guard, consume arguments or wait exit invalidate the respective static result. Changed live inputs, opaque calls or later state changes can invalidate a runtime interpretation without changing the instructions.
RVA-F-0333.conclusion: A specialized Move branch can consume an ICBM after either selected interception or a conditional damage-helper call. Gameplay consumption, gameplay outcome and visible presentation are separate. Missing pixels alone do not demonstrate a missing gameplay effect; a consumed missile alone does not demonstrate successful damage.
